      Manual: restrict config/somebuckets-server.json to water and run /reload; Source Buckets refuse lava input and output while Big Buckets still handle lava.     • server_config_file_loads_entries_and_recreates_defaults

      @GameTest(structure="somebuckets:empty_9x6x9", maxTicks=20) public void server_config_file_loads_entries_and_recreates_defaults(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Manual: stop the server, add lava, an unknown id, and malformed entries to config/somebuckets-server.json, restart, and verify only lava is allowed; then stop the server, delete the file, restart, and verify it is recreated with the shipped defaults. Automation: restores the original file and resolved policy after exercising both loads.
